outcome: Frequency of patients administered extemporaneous preparations
Use of specific active pharmaceutical ingredients
cohort: The study included paediatric patients (4905 in 2009 and 4718 in 2019) at a Swedish university hospital.
finding: The frequency of inpatients administered one or more extemporaneous preparations increased from 22% in 2009 to 40% in 2019 (p<0.0001).
